description: AI Literacy: The country measure of AI Literacy, as measured by The Global AI Index (GAII)
AI Receptivity: Measure of IA receptivity by Ipsos, the average of: var10, var11, var12, and var13
Human Development Index: Human Development Index (HDI) measured by the United Nations Development Programme
Life Expectancy: Life expectancy in a country
Education: The average of var6 and var7
Will change my life: Products and services using artificial intelligence will profoundly change my daily life in the next 3-5 years - index from 1-100
Make life easier: Products and services using artificial intelligence make my life easier - index from 1-100
Benefits: Products and services using artificial intelligence have more benefits than drawbacks - index from 1-100
Trust companies with AI: I trust companies using artificial intelligence as much as I trust other companies - index from 1-100
